import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD = -3;
    static final int CAPSULE = ROOM;

    static int[][] grid = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] capsuleCount = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] poisonGrid = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] mx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] my = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static class Position {
        int x, y, cnt;
        Position() {}
        Position(int a, int b, int c) { x = a; y = b; cnt = c; }
    }

    static List<Position> humans = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Position> escapePods = new ArrayList<>();

    static boolean okCell(int x, int y, int n) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n && grid[x][y] == ROOM;
    }

    static int kindOf(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (c == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (c == 'Z') return BAD;
        return -1;
    }

    static int quantityOf(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static void spreadPoison(int x, int y, int timeLimit, int n) {
        poisonGrid[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= timeLimit; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (poisonGrid[t - 1][i][j] == 1) {
                        poisonGrid[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = i + mx[d];
                            int ny = j + my[d];
                            if (okCell(nx, ny, n)) {
                                poisonGrid[t][nx][ny] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int timeNeeded(Position a, Position b, int n, int limit) {
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[n][n];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, a.x, a.y});
        seen[a.x][a.y] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int tim = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            if (x == b.x && y == b.y) return tim;
            if (tim == limit) continue;
            if (poisonGrid[tim][x][y] == 1) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + mx[d];
                int ny = y + my[d];
                if (okCell(nx, ny, n) && !seen[nx][ny] && poisonGrid[tim][nx][ny] == 0) {
                    seen[nx][ny] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{tim + 1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static class ArrayMaxFlow {
        int n, edgeCnt;
        int[] head;
        ArrayList<Integer> to, cap, flow, nxt;
        int[] parent, parentEdge;

        ArrayMaxFlow(int _n) {
            n = _n;
            edgeCnt = 0;
            head = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            to = new ArrayList<>();
            cap = new ArrayList<>();
            flow = new ArrayList<>();
            nxt = new ArrayList<>();
            parent = new int[n];
            parentEdge = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            to.add(v);
            cap.add(c);
            flow.add(0);
            nxt.add(head[u]);
            head[u] = edgeCnt++;
            to.add(u);
            cap.add(0);
            flow.add(0);
            nxt.add(head[v]);
            head[v] = edgeCnt++;
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Arrays.fill(parentEdge, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            parent[s] = s;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = nxt.get(e)) {
                    int v = to.get(e);
                    if (parent[v] == -1 && cap.get(e) - flow.get(e) > 0) {
                        parent[v] = u;
                        parentEdge[v] = e;
                        if (v == t) return true;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int augment(int s, int t) {
            int pushed = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                int e = parentEdge[v];
                pushed = Math.min(pushed, cap.get(e) - flow.get(e));
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                int e = parentEdge[v];
                flow.set(e, flow.get(e) + pushed);
                flow.set(e ^ 1, flow.get(e ^ 1) - pushed);
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                total += augment(s, t);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        Position badReactor = new Position(0, 0, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = kindOf(ch);
                int amount = quantityOf(ch);
                grid[i][j] = type;
                if (type == ROOM && amount > 0) {
                    humans.add(new Position(i, j, amount));
                }
                if (type == BAD) {
                    badReactor = new Position(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = kindOf(ch);
                int amount = quantityOf(ch);
                if (type == CAPSULE && amount > 0) {
                    escapePods.add(new Position(i, j, amount));
                    capsuleCount[i][j] = amount;
                }
            }
        }

        ArrayMaxFlow flow = new ArrayMaxFlow(MAXN);
        int source = 0;
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < humans.size(); ++i) {
            flow.addEdge(source, i * 2 + 1, humans.get(i).cnt);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < escapePods.size(); ++i) {
            flow.addEdge(i * 2 + 2, sink, escapePods.get(i).cnt);
        }

        spreadPoison(badReactor.x, badReactor.y, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < humans.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < escapePods.size(); ++j) {
                int t = timeNeeded(humans.get(i), escapePods.get(j), N, T);
                if (t <= T) {
                    flow.addEdge(i * 2 + 1, j * 2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.maxFlow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
